purpose: Browser-first visual roles. Released humans use the Quaternius Universal base, native head and hair layers, deterministic identity recipes, and validated bone-attached equipment; monsters use retained animated CC0 sources with role profiles.

sky_system.notes: Generated by VisualDirector: sky color, sun disc, cloud planes, fog and zone lighting.

grass_material.notes: Generated in-game as batched multimesh grass blades with zone-tuned color.

road_cobble_material.notes: Generated in-game as layered rough stone road material for Greyfen.

mud_road_material.notes: Generated in-game as wet dark road material for Wychwood.

player_human.notes: Complete clothed Universal body assembly with native face, brows, eyes, role hair, one shared skeleton, deterministic role palette, and 1K maps.

road_ranger_human.source: Quaternius Modular Character Outfits: Fantasy, optimized runtime export
road_ranger_human.notes: Complete 65-bone skinned Ranger outfit with native hood/body pieces, shared non-root-motion UAL2 clips, and 1K runtime maps. Used by Captain Senn and road ranger roles.

halvern_boss.source: Quaternius Modular Character Outfits: Fantasy, optimized runtime export
halvern_boss.notes: Reviewed complete shared-skeleton body and UAL2 animation, with authored hand-bone Sword.fbx, calibrated grip, and no proxy anatomy. Runtime approval and dependency hashes are owned by runtime_asset_manifest.json.

bandit_deserter.source: Quaternius Universal Base Characters and Modular Character Outfits: Fantasy
bandit_deserter.notes: Armored 65-bone Ranger/Universal assembly with native face and single-material atlas. In-world combat and composition acceptance pending.

bandit_tracker.source: Quaternius Universal Base Characters and Modular Character Outfits: Fantasy
bandit_tracker.notes: Light scout 65-bone Peasant/Ranger/Universal assembly with native face and single-material atlas. In-world combat and composition acceptance pending.

ghoul_gaunt_real.notes: Compatibility alias retained for old role IDs; runtime uses the validated Skeleton source with gaunt profile styling.

orc_skull_real.notes: Legacy role alias now resolves to the retained validated source; the rejected cartoon source is no longer an active reference.

ghoul_stalker_real.notes: Compatibility alias retained for old role IDs; runtime uses the validated Skeleton source with stalker profile styling.

ghoul_brute_real.notes: Compatibility alias retained for old role IDs; runtime uses the validated Skeleton source with brute profile styling.

ghoulkin_skeleton.notes: Retained articulated source for all Wychwood family roles; deterministic scale, material, posture, and attack profiles provide silhouette variation without duplicate meshes.
